name: 5a2
query:
// Find patients who gave negative feedback and what issues they reported
MATCH (p:Patient)-[:GIVES_FEEDBACK]->(f:Feedback_Comment {overall_sentiment: "negative"})
MATCH (p)-[:EXPERIENCES]->(i:Issue)
RETURN p.patientID AS Patient, 
       f.raw_text AS Negative_Feedback,
       i.description AS Reported_Issue,
       i.category AS Issue_Category
ORDER BY p.patientID
LIMIT 10;

// Find processes with the most connections (most central/important) - FIXED SYNTAX
MATCH (pa:Process_Activity)
RETURN pa.name AS Process,
       COUNT { MATCH (pa)<-[:UNDERGOES]-() } AS Patients_Connected,
       COUNT { MATCH (pa)<-[:PERFORMS]-() } AS Staff_Connected, 
       COUNT { MATCH (pa)-[:CAUSES]->() } AS Issues_Caused,
       COUNT { MATCH (pa)-[:USES_TECH]->() } AS Technologies_Used,
       COUNT { MATCH (pa)<-[:UNDERGOES]-() } +
       COUNT { MATCH (pa)<-[:PERFORMS]-() } +
       COUNT { MATCH (pa)-[:CAUSES]->() } +
       COUNT { MATCH (pa)-[:USES_TECH]->() } AS Total_Connections
ORDER BY Total_Connections DESC
LIMIT 10;
